reasoning_chain.name: Reporting: master/operator report to Affected State; flag State transmits; Affected State notifies mariners/owner/flag (Art. 5)
Hazard determination: Affected State uses available means (hydrographic surveys) and Art. 1.5 criteria (Art. 6)
Marking: Affected State ensures reasonable steps to mark (publish info; mark per international standards) (Art. 7.1)
Removal options: Affected State may remove (Art. 7.2) or permit owner to remove subject to conditions (Art. 7.3, 8, 9)

Liability: registered owner strictly liable for locating/marking/removing costs, subject to three defences (Art. 10.1); excluded where conflicts with CLC/HNS/Bunker (Art. 10.2); no liability if Affected State negligence (Art. 10.3); may limit liability (Art. 10.4-10.5)
Compulsory insurance: ships of 300 gt+ must maintain insurance/security; certificate issued (Art. 11, Annex)
Certificates and direct action: certificate carried on board; direct action against insurer; insurer may limit/defend (Art. 12)
Time limits: 3 years from hazard determination; 6 years absolute bar from casualty (Art. 13)
